channel.title: Pier & Point · Shared Public Way paseo
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Shared Public Way paseo (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Shared Public Way paseo: The open question about this paseo now says that Pier & Point's…
item.description: The open question about this paseo now says that Pier & Point's founder saw it open on October 27, 2026; no photograph was taken. The status stays complete. No source read names this paseo on its own as built or accepted, and the question still says so. Source: Pier & Point founder's site visit, Oct 27, 2026 (no photograph).
item.source: Pier & Point founder's site visit, Oct 27, 2026 (no photograph)

item.title: Correction · Shared Public Way paseo: On the Shared Public Way paseo timeline, the February 11…
item.description: On the Shared Public Way paseo timeline, the February 11, 2025 infrastructure acceptance used to appear twice, from two tables with different wording; it now appears once. The entry that stays now sets the status to complete, cites the Port's June 2026 memo and says the minutes do not name this paseo. Dates and statuses are unchanged and no source was dropped. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · Shared Public Way paseo: The Mission Rock Design Controls list the open space as…
item.description: The Mission Rock Design Controls list the open space as "Section 4.2 Paseo: Shared Public Way". The old name added a street name and 'north segment' in a parenthetical. The record's open questions already say that no Port document read says which street took the name Dr Maya Angelou Lane, so the street name no longer sits in the record's name; 'Dr Maya Angelou Lane (north segment)' still finds the record in search. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address redirects to the new one. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf), Figure 3.1.1, p.45: "Section 4.2 Paseo: Shared Public Way".
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf), Figure 3.1.1, p.45: "Section 4.2 Paseo: Shared Public Way"

item.title: Correction · Shared Public Way paseo: The developer's Phase 1 overview, submitted to the Port in…
item.description: The developer's Phase 1 overview, submitted to the Port in July 2019, lists a pedestrian paseo between Parcels A and G among the Phase 1 public spaces; matching it to the Shared Public Way is Pier & Point's reading. The Port's documents date the Phase 1 submittal April 4, 2019, while the overview says December 4, 2018, revised April 24, 2019. No Port document read says what Exposition Street is called now. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2011D%20Attachment%201%20Mission%20Rock%20Draft%20Phase%201%20Submittal%20Summary_06%2027%2019_2.pdf; https://sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2010B%20Mission%20Rock%20New%20Street%20Names%20Staff%20Report.pdf; https://www.sfport.com/files/2023-10/101023_8b_mission_rock_budget_port_capital_parcel_lease_amendment_final.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Shared Public Way paseo: The status stays complete, but the record's notes and its…
item.description: The status stays complete, but the record's notes and its earlier change entry no longer say the paseo was built on the strength of the 2019 Phase 1 submittal, which was only a forecast. They now cite the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes (staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G) and the Port's June 2026 report (Phase 1 completed in 2025; the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure); neither names this paseo individually. The Port's Oct 2023 report is now cited for Parcel A being The Canyon and Parcel G's Visa work. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone now cites the Sep 2019 Port memo that states the date, and notes that the memo numbers that resolution 18-05 while the January 26 staff report requested it as 18-04. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2025-02-11 (https://sfport.com/media/10214/download); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 8B staff report, 2023-10-06 (https://www.sfport.com/files/2023-10/101023_8b_mission_rock_budget_port_capital_parcel_lease_amendment_final.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2025-02-11 (https://sfport.com/media/10214/download); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 8B staff report, 2023-10-06 (https://www.sfport.com/files/2023-10/101023_8b_mission_rock_budget_port_capital_parcel_lease_amendment_final.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf)

item.title: Correction · Shared Public Way paseo: The Feb 11, 2025 milestone said the Port Commission accepted…
item.description: The Feb 11, 2025 milestone said the Port Commission accepted Mission Rock Phase 1's streets and paseos 'including this one'. The minutes record Resolution 25-05 authorizing Port staff to accept the public infrastructure the developer built (streets, sidewalks, parks and open spaces), with Board of Supervisors action still to follow, and do not name this paseo individually. The milestone now says so, and cites the Port's June 2026 memo, which says the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure. Source: Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (https://www.sfport.com/media/10214/download); https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf.

item.title: Added · Shared Public Way paseo: The Shared Public Way paseo between The Canyon and the Visa…
item.description: The Shared Public Way paseo between The Canyon and the Visa building added on its real lot. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned it as part of Phase 1; the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and the Port's June 2026 report says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure. Source: 2019 Phase 1 submittal; Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214); Port Item 8B memo, Oct 6 2023 (Parcel A, The Canyon; Parcel G Visa); Port Item 11A memo, June 5 2026; DataSF Parcels.
item.source: 2019 Phase 1 submittal; Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214); Port Item 8B memo, Oct 6 2023 (Parcel A, The Canyon; Parcel G Visa); Port Item 11A memo, June 5 2026; DataSF Parcels

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09.

item.title: Complete · Shared Public Way paseo: Port Commission passes Resolutions 25-05 and… (Feb 11, 2025)
item.description: Port Commission passes Resolutions 25-05 and 25-06 unanimously to accept Phase 1 public infrastructure; staff describe 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' as Port owned; the minutes do not name this paseo individually (Feb 11, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-02-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09.

item.title: Planned · Shared Public Way paseo: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design… (Jan 30, 2018)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls (their April 24, 2018 final version names this planned street the Shared Public Way (Section 4.2, p.80; the earlier version the Commission approved was not read)); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sep 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018). Source: Port Commission Item 11A staff report, Jan 26 2018 (request), https://sfport.com/media/3259/download; Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sep 20 2019 (approval date), https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf; Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24 2018 final version (street name), https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf.
